{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABYfcT2A", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhCDs70", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 5, "title": "Implement the evidence-tagged 1996 MAIN menu and screen-scoped command navigation", "body": "## Problem

The interface needs PC-VAN-specific navigation rather than generic BBS commands. Applying a global guessed set of keys or combining menu revisions would produce false historical behavior.

## Expected outcome

On entering the app the user can operate a reconstructed 1996 MAIN by number and supported jump commands, with menus rendered from provenance-tagged fixture data and behavior determined by the current screen.

## Context

Depends on the historical fixture Issue and terminal-shell Issue. Use the fixture from `data/pcvan`, not a separately maintained hard-coded copy.

1996 approximate MAIN (retrospective transcription, **not confirmed for all of 1997**): `1 電子メール; 2 索引; 3 ニュース; 4 データベース; 5 公共情報と政治; 6 ビジネス; 7 インターネット; 8 コンピュータ; 9 ショッピングモール; 10 電子出版; 11 趣味; 12 生活; 13 コミュニケーション; 14 PC-VAN利用情報（無料）; 15 おすすめ; 16 わかばマーク; 17 BIGLOBEガイド; 18 インターサイト; 19 BIGLOBEイベント（無料）; 20 BIGLOBE情報誌ご案内; 21 オリンピック特設コーナー; X 旧電子メール; Q 終了`. Source: https://paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm

Contemporaneous `J` example: https://www.asyura2.com/profile.htm (`J MITI`, then `3`, then `9`). Historical ECOM prompt example, **not** generic SIG command evidence: https://elestamp.o.oo7.jp/Computer_history.htm.

Menu item `13` enters a Communication area, but its exact sub-menu contents/prompt for this era are **not confirmed**. A provisional navigation bridge is acceptable when visibly identified as reconstructed. Do not invent functionality for all 21 entries.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Show the entire 1996 MAIN fixture with two-column numbered item layout and X/Q; preserve input-to-label mappings and original Japanese wording from the fixture.
- [ ] Introduce a small screen state machine and per-screen allowed command handlers; numeric commands are interpreted in the active menu, not globally.
- [ ] Support `J MITI` jumping to the designated SIG route; unknown targets/invalid commands get a helpful terminal error while preserving state; commands do not accidentally invoke browser navigation.
- [ ] Support MAIN `Q` ending the simulated connection and a clear way to reconnect; a command is not asserted to have historical semantics on screens where its behavior is unverified.
- [ ] Make `13` reachable without inventing a verified historical Communication submenu; label any convenience bridge/placeholder as reconstructed, and keep unsupported entries non-destructive.
- [ ] Keep different historical MAIN variants in separate data rather than merging their labels or commands.
- [ ] Add tests for all MAIN mappings, `J MITI`, unknown command, Q, and per-screen numeric interpretation.

## Optional validation

None proposed.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.
